audit_events_actor_identity_check.name: audit_events_actor_identity_check
audit_events_actor_identity_check.value: ("audit_events"."actor_role" = 'system' AND "audit_events"."actor_id" IS NULL) OR ("audit_events"."actor_role" IN ('assistant', 'doctor') AND "audit_events"."actor_id" IS NOT NULL)

patients_display_name_check.name: patients_display_name_check
patients_display_name_check.value: "patients"."display_name" = 'ผู้ป่วยทดสอบ ' || substr("patients"."hn", 6)

intake_blood_pressure_relationship_check.name: intake_blood_pressure_relationship_check
intake_blood_pressure_relationship_check.value: "intake_observations"."systolic_mmhg" IS NULL OR "intake_observations"."diastolic_mmhg" IS NULL OR "intake_observations"."systolic_mmhg" >= "intake_observations"."diastolic_mmhg"

inventory_reservations_release_fields_ch.name: inventory_reservations_release_fields_check
inventory_reservations_release_fields_ch.value:
("inventory_reservations"."status" <> 'RELEASED' AND "inventory_reservations"."released_at" IS NULL AND "inventory_reservations"."released_by" IS NULL AND "inventory_reservations"."release_reason" IS NULL)
        OR ("inventory_reservations"."status" = 'RELEASED' AND "inventory_reservations"."released_at" IS NOT NULL AND "inventory_reservations"."released_by" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("inventory_reservations"."release_reason")) BETWEEN 1 AND 500)

inventory_stock_movements_shape_check.name: inventory_stock_movements_shape_check
inventory_stock_movements_shape_check.value: ("inventory_stock_movements"."movement_type" = 'RECEIPT' AND "inventory_stock_movements"."source_type" = 'RECEIPT' AND "inventory_stock_movements"."quantity_delta" > 0) OR ("inventory_stock_movements"."movement_type" = 'DISPENSE' AND "inventory_stock_movements"."source_type" = 'DISPENSE' AND "inventory_stock_movements"."quantity_delta" < 0) OR ("inventory_stock_movements"."movement_type" = 'ADJUSTMENT' AND "inventory_stock_movements"."source_type" = 'ADJUSTMENT')

fulfillment_artifact_invalidations_repla.name: fulfillment_artifact_invalidations_replacement_check
fulfillment_artifact_invalidations_repla.value: ("fulfillment_artifact_invalidations"."trigger" = 'ORDER_REVISION' AND "fulfillment_artifact_invalidations"."replacement_decision_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("fulfillment_artifact_invalidations"."trigger" <> 'ORDER_REVISION' AND "fulfillment_artifact_invalidations"."replacement_decision_id" IS NULL)

fulfillment_preparation_confirmations_ev.name: fulfillment_preparation_confirmations_evidence_check
fulfillment_preparation_confirmations_ev.value: ("fulfillment_preparation_confirmations"."method" = 'BARCODE' AND "fulfillment_preparation_confirmations"."barcode_snapshot" IS NOT NULL AND length("fulfillment_preparation_confirmations"."barcode_snapshot") BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND "fulfillment_preparation_confirmations"."barcode_snapshot" NOT GLOB '*[^!-~]*' AND "fulfillment_preparation_confirmations"."manual_reason" IS NULL) OR ("fulfillment_preparation_confirmations"."method" = 'MANUAL' AND "fulfillment_preparation_confirmations"."barcode_snapshot" IS NULL AND "fulfillment_preparation_confirmations"."manual_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("fulfillment_preparation_confirmations"."manual_reason")) BETWEEN 1 AND 500)

fulfillment_preparations_completion_fiel.name: fulfillment_preparations_completion_fields_check
fulfillment_preparations_completion_fiel.value: ("fulfillment_preparations"."status" = 'ACTIVE' AND "fulfillment_preparations"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "fulfillment_preparations"."completed_by" IS NULL) OR ("fulfillment_preparations"."status" = 'COMPLETED' AND "fulfillment_preparations"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "fulfillment_preparations"."completed_by" IS NOT NULL)
